page.layout: One printed page, framed by an ornamental border. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Full-width epigraph block at top, then a centred heading block, then one column of italic text with a catchword-like signature line "O 2" and "com-" at the foot. Margin notes: none legible on this page; the left edge shows show-through from the facing page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Quod sii id fiat bona fide, ex varia & diversa rerum ventilatione, tanquam ex puteo emerget veritas, & ita Helias artis tandem in lucem prodibit; Cui hanc disputationem impendisse hactenus libuit.
main_text.head: D. FABIANUS DE MONTE S. Sever. in Tract. de Empt. & vend. q. s. n. 8.
main_text.p: SEd hic quæritur incidenter, an Alchemista vel faciens Alchemiam puniatur de falso? Dicus quod Non, quia est Ars perspicaci ingenio inventa, ubi expenditur tantum pro tanto, & tale pro tali, sine aliqua falsificatione formæ vel materia, secund. Andr. de Isern. & Obrad. in Consiliys suis, ut refert Bald. in d. c. 1. Quæ sint Reg. Idem etiam tenet Ioan. Andr. in addit. spec. in tit. de crim. fals. in rub. Hoc insuper firmavit Abb.
